title: Improved Barrels
description: More barrel tiers, from copper to netherite.
body:
This mod adds improved barrels with different tiers.

Upgrade your storage without tearing it down. Improved Barrels adds a clean tiered progression for barrels, from Copper all the way to Netherite, with in‑world upgrades.

![All Improved Barrels](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d9566a145ed3f6d12da861a721b3c92ea2bbafa_0.webp)

### **Compatibility**
Forge (1.20.1).

Sorting mods;

Tinkers’ Construct Crafting Station.

This mod has no dependencies beyond Forge.

Servers: Install on both server and clients (new blocks/items). Existing worlds are safe; upgrading placed barrels is in‑place and lossless.


### **FAQ**

**Q:** Do upgrades drop items or scramble slots?

**A:** No. When a barrel is upgraded, all items inside it stay untouched.

**Q:** Do I need Tinkers’ Construct?

**A:** No. The TCon support is optional. Everything works fine without it.

**Q:** Can I use this in a modpack?

**A:** Yes, modpacks are welcome. Please link back to this page.

**Q:** Client or server?

**A:** Both sides should have the mod installed!


### **Credits**
 This is my first minecraft mod, everything from code to art was made by me. I'll try to update any bugs and errors! Please don't be scared to contact me if needed!
